ops.parking: The parking lot is on B1 and B2 with 61 spaces, and advance reservations are not accepted. Vehicle height limit is 2.1 m. Parking hours are 8:00-22:00; the general rate is 330 yen per 20 minutes, with a maximum of 2,000 yen Mon-Sat and 1,400 yen on Sundays and holidays (8:00-22:00; vehicles cannot enter or exit between 22:00 and 8:00). Guests who use a banquet or meeting get 4 hours free.
ops.waitingRooms: Koto (East Wing 2F, 40.8㎡) can also be used as a waiting room. Pegasus and Orion (West Wing 3F) can be used as waiting spaces until a banquet starts.
ops.catering: The banquet rate applies only when meals of 5,000 yen or more per person are ordered. Vendors designated by the hotel must be used for decorations, flowers, sound, music, banquet companions and gifts; to use a vendor not designated by the hotel, the hotel's prior approval is required. The fee for bringing in equipment such as a PC is 3,300 yen per unit, and the fee for bringing in a hanging sign is 2,200 yen (price list applied from October 1, 2024).
ops.restaurants: On East Wing 1F there are Western Dining Salvia and Café & Bar Cattleya, and on East Wing B1F there is Japanese Cuisine Fuji. Lunch is 11:30-14:30 (last order 14:00) and dinner is 17:00-21:00 (last order 20:30).
